title: Books not yet returned
statementMd:
List loan ids that have not been returned (no return date).

Expected columns: `id`, `book_id`, `member_id`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT id, book_id, member_id FROM loans WHERE return_date IS NULL;
```
